contracts.description: Save, spend, pause, amount confirmation, edit tap, goal/budget links, and swipe actions remain reachable while the card is restyled.

Each temptation card keeps independent lifetime save and spend counts and amounts outside the rolling history-retention window. New actions increase the matching total, while manually deleting an action from History decrements only that card and action total.

A manually configured cadence remains anchored during later actions, while a manual save or spend consumes the current check, suppresses that card from auto-collect for the rest of the local day, invalidates matching pending entries, and schedules the next anchored occurrence. Automatic confirmations preserve their current timer and ledger entry.
Auto-fit text keeps an absolute readable minimum under Fabric instead of falling through to the native 4-point fallback.

The React Native text host accepts the absolute Fabric auto-fit floor and the postinstall step reapplies that fix after dependency installation.
The patched React Native text view config forwards absolute minimum and maximum font sizes to Fabric instead of silently dropping them.

Feed cards keep all existing actions and native vertical scrolling while long-press drag reordering uses stable keys, persists the user order, honors reduced motion, and excludes the level gate and archive from every drop target.

The Feed is one continuous category-filtered surface: calendar-aware temptations due today stay first, checked-today temptations remain full actionable cards below the unfinished ones, and all other temptations continue underneath without a separate Today filter. Today's series progress is visible before the first card decision without starting persisted series state; the first due decision still starts that state, same-day history restores checked badges, and Continue after the completion ritual leaves the current screen and scroll position unchanged. Save rewards are credited to the balance immediately while the asset-backed chest remains a claim-once visual summary, so dismissing the chest or crossing midnight cannot lose earned coins. The flow still offers Skip and Not mine → Edit/Archive, asks for the next-check timer after the first save or spend on each temptation. Automatic soft paywall timing is independent of card decisions and series completion. 2026-10-02: user explicitly retired the old Today carousel/tools entry and post-series auto-scroll; utility destinations are preserved on the redesigned Today/Progress surfaces.

contracts.description: Hydrated daily cards can reopen a premature collected chest. The reclaimed balance and backup are persisted alongside the repaired series, the premature modal closes, and its presentation marker is cleared for the real completion.

The persisted series reducer snapshots today's target temptations, reconciles legacy all-card snapshots with today's schedule and history without changing its economy, counts each target only once, and records repeat actions. Every new reward is marked credited immediately; midnight resets only the visual series. Legacy pending rewards are recoverable exactly once, the chest never double-pays already credited rewards, and a later day starts a fresh visual series.

Coin hydration distinguishes a failed or corrupt read from a real zero, restores from the versioned backup or legacy pet snapshot, migrates old uncredited series rewards, and applies a one-time balance floor from save history in the confirmed deferred-reward incident window. It only enables balance persistence after a successful read. Primary, backup, and repair marker values are written together, failed queued writes remain queued for retry, and an explicit account reset clears both balance copies while completing the repair marker.

Home, Progress, and Almi derive colored coin tokens from the same full five-tier denomination resolver. Exact rollover boundaries replace lower colors, non-zero balances never render as an empty zero, and the Almi header no longer hard-codes only blue and green tiers.

The pure balance resolver accepts only finite non-negative values, gives a valid primary zero precedence over an older backup, validates versioned backups, and uses legacy pet coins only when the primary and backup are unavailable or corrupt. The same module owns deterministic denomination rollover and visible-token fallback. Its incident repair counts unique vulnerable save rewards, ignores pre-incident and explicitly credited saves, raises the balance only to the resulting floor, and records a one-time marker.

A user's first-ever resolved temptation queues one persisted, non-blocking next-decision coach independently of attribution and monetization install markers. The Feed may switch to All only when the target is outside the current filter, maps the target to its virtualized feed index and auto-scrolls there rather than trusting a cell-local layout offset, keeps the real card actions interactive, and permanently completes the coach after a second distinct resolution, an explicit dismissal, a filter change, or an unavailable target.

The pure coach policy gates the hook to an eligible first-decision journey with no previous lifetime decision or series resolution, without consulting attribution or monetization install flags; it restores interrupted visible coaches as pending and selects the next unresolved temptation in feed order while excluding the source.
